newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY SESSION MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY SESSION MIXED.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on the U.S. dollar and the rand but closed easier against European currencies after Tuesday's fairly brisk interbank session, dealers said.
"We witnessed quite a bit of movement today, there were (U.S. dollar) sellers at around 11.2800," one dealer said.
"It looks like some of the tobacco funds are beginning to come in now," he added.

The annual tobacco auctions, a major foreign currency earner for the southern African country, are set to officially open in April and dealers have predicted this will boost the local currency against the key U.S. dollar.
Meanwhile on Tuesday, the Zimbabwe dollar finished at 11.2675/2775 against the U.S. dollar, recovering from a 11.2825/2925 low in the morning. It closed on Monday at 11.2750/2850.

Against the crosses, the local dollar was quoted weaker at 18.2100/2300 against sterling compared to 18.1440/1670, at 6.6700/6900 from 6.6690/6770 versus the mark but edged up to 2.5400/5600 from 2.5425/5460 on the rand.
